generation.explanation: The chance is about **8.3%**, assuming “90% accurate” means 90% sensitivity and 90% specificity. Among 1,000 people, about 9 sick people test positive—but so do 99 healthy people. So only 9 of the 108 positive results indicate disease: 9 ÷ 108 ≈ 8.3%.
